# Elliot Rylands

> A design engineer helping product ideas find their feet, then pushing them to production. Currently building jane.app at Jane (healthcare practice management software), from Cochrane, Alberta, Canada. Sixteen years in product and growth.

## Previously

- Scan.com: Staff Product Designer. Booking and charting portals for imaging.
- Squiz: Senior Product Designer and design lead. Merging a suite of CMS products into one digital experience platform.
- UK Government: a self-service hub serving 17 departments.
- Papa John's: ordering flow and global design system.
- GCTV: onboarding and multi-race live viewing for a streaming platform.
- Titan Tennis: native app for a smart tennis ball machine.
- Also: Coca-Cola, Santander, William Hill, Suzuki and SnipIt.
